'''2022 PC20 Brad Eier LS No Idea''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brad Eier]] at [[2022 PC20 Tournament]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brad Eier]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 PC20 Tournament]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open They Have No Idea We're Comi Eier L.txt |Download]]
